description: A format preference for project status reports, asked about for sales reports. Limit: recall admits a memory that shares one informative word with the question, with no check that the subject is the same. Failure means: memory-on-unrelated-question or fact-leaked, the narrow preference applied to a different object; offline the abstention probe passes only when nothing is retrieved. The abstain and the no-memory probe share one cause (a memory admitted on one shared word), so they usually fail together. Maintenance: run with maintenance on or off; the seeded record is younger than 94 days. Kind: defect.
